title: Server-side NIN/BVN verification, BVN step fix and holder-name match (identity batch 2: ONA-ID-203, 205)

requirements.expectation: Signup looks a supplied 11-digit NIN/BVN up on the server before the account is created. A provider rejection returns 422 id_verification_failed and an unavailable provider returns 503 id_verification_unavailable; nothing is created in either case.
requirements.verification: Unit test of checkSignupIds and signup route test.
evidence: code: src/lib/server/identity/__tests__/id-lookup.test.ts covers rejection (422), unavailable (503), incomplete numbers skipped and no call when nothing is supplied.
code: src/app/api/auth/signup/__tests__/route.test.ts asserts 422 and 503 with createUser not called and no account writes.

requirements.expectation: gov_id_meta.idLookup.{nin,bvn} holds status, provider, mode, reference, matched name, name match and time, never the raw number. Storing is best-effort and cannot fail signup.
requirements.verification: Unit test of buildIdLookupRecord, mergeIdLookup and storeIdLookup; signup route test.
evidence: code: id-lookup.test.ts asserts the exact record shape, that the number is absent, that existing meta keys survive the merge, and that a failing write does not throw.
code: signup route test asserts the stored record for a new motorist and a new Repair Pro and that neither number appears in it.

requirements.expectation: Motorist signup writes nin_verified and bvn_verified false and identity_verified_at null whatever digits are supplied; the signup response reports the stored flags. A Care-approved row is never downgraded.
evidence: code: signup route test asserts false flags, null identity_verified_at and false response extras for a motorist with NIN and BVN, and false flags for a new Repair Pro.

code: signup route test asserts re-attaching an existing motorist role returns 409 role_exists and leaves the approved row byte-for-byte unchanged. The upsert's defensive keep-approved branch is therefore not reachable through this route and has no direct test.

requirements.expectation: pro-id (BVN step and NIN/BVN government ID) and customer-id (Nigerian NIN/BVN) store the lookup outcome. A rejected or unavailable lookup does not block the submission; other document types and other countries make no provider call.
evidence: code: src/app/api/verify/__tests__/id-submission-lookup.test.ts covers BVN step, national ID, a rejected lookup (still 200, recorded as rejected), passport (no call), customer NIN+BVN and a non-Nigerian ID (no call).

requirements.expectation: The nin kind of pro-id, sent only by the onboarding BVN step, writes bvn_encrypted, bvn_last4, bank_id_number and the BVN meta keys, and no longer overwrites nin_encrypted, nin_last4, gov_id_number or NIN meta keys.
requirements.verification: Route test; UI inspection of src/components/artisan/artisan-onboarding/bvn-tier.tsx and use-verify-actions.ts.
evidence: code: id-submission-lookup.test.ts asserts the BVN lands in the BVN fields while the previously stored NIN fields and meta.primaryId are unchanged and meta.nin is not written.
code: bvn-tier.tsx titles the step 'BVN · Tier 3' with placeholder '11-digit BVN'; use-verify-actions.ts is the only caller of kind 'nin'.

requirements.expectation: Names are compared ignoring case, spacing, punctuation, accents and order. A match needs the surname plus one other name (two shared names when the provider gives no surname). Results are match, mismatch or unknown.
evidence: code: src/lib/server/identity/__tests__/name-match.test.ts covers order, case, punctuation, accents, missing surname, missing second name, double surnames, the no-surname fallback and too-little-to-compare inputs.

requirements.expectation: No lookup result sets a verified flag. Admin pro-review rows (t2_id.id_lookup) and customer-review rows (identity.id_lookup) carry the records and a name_mismatch flag. No payout code is changed.
requirements.verification: Unit and route tests; diff inspection.
evidence: code: id-lookup.test.ts asserts idLookupSummary sets name_mismatch for a profile or bank-account mismatch and false otherwise.
code: signup and submission route tests assert verified flags stay false after a live confirmation, including one with a name mismatch.
code: git diff touches no file under src/lib/server/payments or any file listed in docs/RULES.md section 10.
code: the two admin GET handlers have no route test; the added line calls the unit-tested idLookupSummary on the row's gov_id_meta.

requirements.expectation: The full local check suite passes.
requirements.verification: npm test, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run check:server-boundaries, npm run check:openapi-drift.
evidence: code: 225 Vitest files pass; eslint 0 errors (143 warnings, none introduced); tsc --noEmit exits 0; check:server-boundaries verified; check:openapi-drift ok (187 route files, none missing).

requirements.expectation: With the provider key set on the host, signup rejects a wrong NIN/BVN, stores the record for a right one, and the admin review data shows the mismatch flag.
requirements.verification: Live QA on the hosted environment.

code: Render id_lookup and the name_mismatch flag in the admin verification screens; today it is only in the API rows.
Product decision: should a name mismatch stop Care approval from setting bvn_verified, or need an explicit override? Today approval is not blocked.
One-off cleanup of motorist rows whose nin_verified / bvn_verified / identity_verified_at were set from number length by earlier signups.
gov_id submissions still store any primary ID number in the nin_* columns; only the BVN step was corrected.
src/app/api/auth/signup/route.ts remains far over the 300-line limit; split it in its own change.
Customer ID submissions compare the holder name with the profile name only; no payout bank account name is read for customers.
external: Set the ID provider key on the host: signup with a NIN or BVN returns 503 in production without it.
Merge batch 1 (fix/otp-and-id-lookup-hardening) first; this branch is stacked on it.
Independent human review against the implementation commit.
